name: Generative AI Art
description: Generate full-screen abstract art for your split-flap display using your FiestaBoard AI provider. Each piece is a unique, thought-out composition using the board's 8-color palette, composed for whatever board it lands on — Flagship, Note, a note array up to 120x24, or a FiestaPanel up to 128x96.
author: FiestaBoard Team

ai_provider.title: AI Provider
ai_provider.description: Which of your FiestaBoard AI providers (Settings → AI Providers) composes the art. Leave empty for FiestaBot's default provider. Not used when a separate API key is set below.

ai_model.title: AI Model
ai_model.description: Optional model for the AI provider above. Leave empty for the provider's default model.

api_key.title: Use a separate API key (optional)
api_key.description: Only if you want this plugin to skip your FiestaBoard AI providers. When set, it always wins and is sent to the Separate API Base URL with the Separate API Model below. Use any value (e.g. 'ollama') for local endpoints that don't require auth.

api_base_url.title: Separate API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Used only with a separate API key: base URL for an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama).

model.title: Separate API Model
model.description: Used only with a separate API key: the model name at that endpoint.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: LLM sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 2 = very random). 1.0–1.4 works well for art.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to generate a new art piece. Minimum 300 seconds (5 minutes).

themes.title: Custom Themes
themes.description: Optional list of theme prompts. Leave empty to use the built-in theme pool.

extra_instructions.title: Extra Prompt Instructions
extra_instructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the system prompt (e.g. 'favor cool colors' or 'avoid red entirely')

custom_system_prompt.title: Custom System Prompt
custom_system_prompt.description: Override the full system prompt sent to the LLM. Leave blank to use the built-in prompt, which is written for the board being rendered. When set, Extra Prompt Instructions is ignored, and the same prompt is used on every board — so write it board-agnostically. Use the generator's build_default_system_prompt(canvas) method to see the default.

show_title.title: Show Title
show_title.description: Display a centered title on the bottom row of the board. When enabled, the art fills all rows except the last one.

env_vars.name: GENERATIVE_AI_ART_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Optional separate API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; when set it is used instead of your FiestaBoard AI providers

env_vars.name: GENERATIVE_AI_ART_API_BASE_URL
env_vars.description: Base URL for the chat completions endpoint

env_vars.name: GENERATIVE_AI_ART_SHOW_TITLE
env_vars.description: Show a centered title on the bottom row (true/false)

art.description: Full-board color art pattern, sized to the board being rendered (one tile per cell, rows separated by newlines)

theme.description: Theme or concept of the current art piece

description.description: Short artist's description of the current piece
description.example: Radiating rings of cool blues fading to deep violet

model.description: LLM model that generated this piece

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when this piece was generated
